precepts.text: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit. So there are going to be those that separate themselves. Sensual, having not the spirit of the Lord. How can we prove that? What does the Lord require us to do on the holy Sabbath day? So when the spirit rises up in you to stay at home, or to play Sabbath sick, or to forsake the assembling of ourselves together, whose spirit are you moving in? The Lord is about unity. The Lord has never been about separation. So when that spirit rises up in you, you have to be able to recognise it and then force yourself past that point. Because do you wake up every day on the right side of the bed? Do you wake up and everything is perfect? But you have to push past it. You do not call off work every day. You still go to work, you still shuffle the white man's papers and stand by the coffee machine and act interested in the job, but you do not really want to be there, and you still go. The hope is that once we are among each other, someone who has the spirit of the Lord can be so infectious that it can jump on me and I can get in the spirit of the Lord.
precepts.point: So the seduction is always going to be there. At various times it was Christ did not exist, or Christ did not die on the cross, or Christ did not rise from the dead, or now Christ is a white man, when there is not one scriptural proof to back it up. Why? Because Satan's spirit worketh in the children of disobedience. God gave commandments. You learn the commandments. And then you say, we can eat whatever we want, we can worship the Lord on Sunday, we do not have to keep the Sabbath day holy. You have now become disobedient, because God gave clear instructions on what we are commanded to do.

note.label: Stay in the Spirit

precepts.why:
John writes “concerning them that seduce you”, and verse 27 shows how the seduction comes: “ye need not that any man teach you”. The antichrist is going to try to teach you something. He isn't floating in the air going boo; he's teaching. What do you think all these apologetics are? That is the spirit of antichrist. Does that mean the bishops and deacons can't teach us? No. It is the ones who fell away: “They went out from us, but they were not of us”, and now all of a sudden they want to teach you.

Jude shows who they are: “These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.” There will be those who separate themselves, sensual, not having the spirit of the Lord. How can we prove it? What does the Lord require of us on the holy Sabbath day? So when the spirit rises up in you to stay at home, to play Sabbath sick, to forsake the assembling of ourselves together, whose spirit are you moving in? You see how simple that is. The Lord is about unity; he has never been about separation.

When that spirit rises up in you, recognize it, say Satan is trying to get me, and force yourself past that point. Do you wake up every day on the right side of the bed, everything perfect? No, but you push past it. You don't call off work every day. You still go shuffle the white man's papers, stand by the coffee machine and the water cooler and act interested in the job when you don't want to be there. The hope is that once we are among each other, someone who has the spirit of the Lord can be so infectious that it jumps on me, and I get in the spirit of the Lord.

The gripes and unresolved issues, hatred and jealousy, are what Satan uses as a reason to send you back to Caesar Borgia: he spoke rough to me, he didn't say anything to me. Some brothers and sisters, no matter what you do, you can't make them happy; some are ordained to be that sensual brother or sister. That is why we have to stay in the spirit.

precepts.text: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith. The key is yourselves. We can go over scriptures until we are blue in the face, but it is up to you to build up yourself, to study and apply. Study, pray, apply: that is upon every man and every woman. It is like the gym: the weights are there, put them to use. Likewise with the word of God.
precepts.point: As ye have been taught: some of the leadership from the old school went off, and the doctrine became that everything they taught was wrong, so throw it away and go back to Christianity. Did King Solomon go off? Do we rip out the book of Proverbs? Did King David go off? Do we rip out the book of Psalms? Men make mistakes, men do fall, but when they were in their prime they were teaching properly. You do not throw the baby away with the bath water.

note.label: Deceived by Enticing Words: Colossians 2

precepts.why:
Colossians says “Rooted and built up in him.” Jude says who does the building: “But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost.”

The key is yourselves. We can go over scriptures until we are blue in the face, but it is up to you to build yourself up, to study and apply. Study, pray, apply. That is upon every man and every woman; we cannot do it for you.

It is like going to the gym. Deacon Abiel goes twice a day, but if he just sat there and ate a sandwich he would not be building himself up; he would come back a Teletubby all over again. The weights are there; put them to use. Likewise with the word of God. Everybody has a Bible, everybody has the app. Study it, pray on it and apply it, and you will be rooted and built up in him and stablished in the faith.

precepts.text: There are certain men crept in unawares, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ. Everything in the Bible with them turned into sexual immorality. Those spirits are back today.
precepts.point: Not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh: other translations read, but are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh. These men were fasting, praying, and sacrificing, yet they were still sexually indulgent all over the place. When it came to satisfying the flesh, they had no honor.

note.label: Deceived by Enticing Words: Colossians 2

precepts.why:
When it came to satisfying the flesh, these men had no honour. No honour. Jude names them: “For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.”

Lasciviousness means sexual immorality. They turned the grace of God into it, and they denied the Father and the Son. Everything in the Bible with them turned out to be some sex: I could get two wives, three wives, four wives. This woman make me mad, I got two more women over there I’mma deal with, then I’mma take your money and you buy me a Maserati. The hell is this? These dudes are wicked as hell.

Those spirits are back today. That is why Paul warns about a show of wisdom in will worship and humility and neglecting of the body that is not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh: men who look religious and fast, but whose god is sex.

precepts.text: How that all our fathers were under the cloud: right here it tells you who the people in Corinth are. They were not Greeks or Europeans; they were Israelites: our fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Under the cloud: the chariot that followed us. They drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them, and that Rock was Christ. But with many of them God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness: for murmuring, gossiping, fornication. These things were our examples, that we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
precepts.point: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh: other nations, and worse, as it is today. They are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire: that lake of fire we read about in Revelation 14.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
Jude says “I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.” He is going into history. When we left Egypt we went into the wilderness, and the Israelites rebelled and were put to death. Who else spoke of it in the New Testament? Paul, in Corinthians the tenth chapter. Write that down in your Bible.

“Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud”. Right here it tells you who the people in Corinth were. They weren't white people, weren't Europeans, weren't natural Greeks, Caucasians. They were Israelites: our fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, not Abraham, Isaac and Esau. Under the cloud: the chariot that followed us. They “all passed through the sea; And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea”, because Moses taught the law and taught us Christ, the gospel.

“And did all eat the same spiritual meat; And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.” Christ was always present. “But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness”: for murmuring, gossiping, sex, fornication.

“Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.” These things were our examples, brothers. That is what Jude puts us in remembrance of: God saved a whole people and still destroyed those who believed not. Don't lust after evil things as they did, and earnestly contend for the faith once delivered unto the saints.

precepts.text: Men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil. There are people who were ordained of old to stay like that; God gave them up to strong delusion, and some people are bound in that darkness.
precepts.point: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh: other nations, and worse, as it is today. They are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire: that lake of fire we read about in Revelation 14.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
Jude says the angels which kept not their first estate are reserved “in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.” Has that great day come yet, brothers? No. Those sons of God who went in unto the daughters of men were destroyed in the flood, and those spirits came right back, by way of the three sons, Ham, Shem and Japheth. They are still here today.

John shows what that darkness is: “And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.” Men loving darkness rather than light is sin: you hate God's laws, you hate this truth, you hate the Bible.

There are people like that who were ordained of old to stay like that, the “certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation”. Remember 2 Thessalonians: God gave them up to strong delusion, that they should believe a lie and not repent and come into the light. Some people are bound in that darkness, and there is nothing you can do for them. That is the chains of darkness, reserved unto the judgment of the great day.

precepts.text: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light: from sin to righteousness. And from the power of Satan unto God: from the prince of the power of the air, his evil communication, those unclean spirits out of the mouth of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
precepts.point: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh: other nations, and worse, as it is today. They are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire: that lake of fire we read about in Revelation 14.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
Christ sent Paul, “Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee, To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light”. To open our eyes, and turn us from darkness to light: from sin to righteousness.

Then, “and from the power of Satan unto God”: from the power of Satan, the prince of the power of the air, his evil communication, those unclean spirits that went out of the mouth of the dragon, the beast and the false prophet. So “that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.”

That is the other side of Jude. Some are bound in chains of darkness, loving darkness rather than light, ordained of old to that condemnation. But the ones Paul was sent to are turned from darkness to light and from Satan unto God, sanctified by faith in Christ. That is the faith once delivered unto the saints that we are earnestly contending for, casting down Esau's lies about fallen angels and Nephilim.

precepts.text: For if God spared not the angels that sinned: this is not going into literal angels in the heavens sinning against God; they do God's will. It is going into the offspring of the sons of God, delivered into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment: the same great day Jude talked about. And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, and turned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly.
precepts.point: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh: other nations, and worse, as it is today. They are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire: that lake of fire we read about in Revelation 14.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
“But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them”. This is still going into the same ones Jude speaks of, what Esau calls Nephilim, because they are back today: the evil of our people. “And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of. And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you”.

“For if God spared not the angels that sinned”. This is not literal angels up in heaven sinning against God. They cannot sin against God; they do his will, and when God tells them to do something, they do it. Stop listening to Esau, the pastors, preachers and congressmen talking about demons, Nephilim and fallen angels. That is a lie. This is the offspring of the sons of God. He “delivered them into chains of darkness”, and that is sin, “to be reserved unto judgment”, the same great day Jude talked about. What they did back then they will keep doing today; they are not going to change.

“And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly; And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly”. He destroyed the old world with water and saved Noah and his whole family.

So nobody is confused: Jude is not talking about Uriel having a fight with an angel, uppercutting him, and the angel falling from heaven. That is garbage malarkey. Black folks live by the saying there is nothing new under the sun, and we get that from the Bible; apply the same logic here.

precepts.text: Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints. Those armies in heaven following him are the saints in the white robes, the ones that loved not their lives unto the death and received the immortal body. He is coming to execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly of all their ungodly deeds, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
precepts.point: I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army. The kingdoms ruling the earth today really believe they can fight against Christ and the 144,000. And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet, and these both were cast alive into a lake of fire: that is eternal damnation, not regular death. And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth.

note.label: The Book of the Wars of the Lord

precepts.why:
“He that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.” His vesture is “dipped in blood” because the Lord will be warring; enough nations are going to be slaughtered. “And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.” When Christ comes back, he is coming back with armies. You think he is coming back to kiss and shake hands? No. He is coming back for war, for deliverance, for vengeance.

So who are those armies that follow him? Jude answers: “And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints”. That is the armies: the saints in the white robes, the 144,000. Christ is coming back with his top Gs: the brothers that loved not their lives unto the death, that received their immortal body, clothed in fine linen, white and clean. They are coming back with the Lord for vengeance.

“To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.” All the hard speeches they have spoken against the Lord: the Lord is coming for vengeance.

Then “out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations”. He is not using a literal weapon; he is using his words, and he is not coming to save the nations but to destroy them. The beast, America and Europe, and the kings of the earth will really believe they can gather their armies and fight against him and against his army of saints.

precepts.text: Building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost, keep yourselves in the love of God, not in the crosshairs of his wrath; nobody else can save you.
precepts.point: The spirits on those who could care less rub off on leadership too; do not play with what you know you are dealing with. The Lord set this hospital up for you; you do not throw the Tylenol in the trash.

note.label: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

precepts.why:
Isaiah says the Lord keeps him in perfect peace “because he trusteth in thee.” That is the key part. You trust in the Lord, you trust in his words, and you build yourself up. Jude says it: “But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost”.

It is the leaders' job to build the man, but once you have the foundation, it is on you to take the notes from the classes, apply them to yourself and add to them. Do a serious checkup from the neck up. Take an erasable dry marker to your mirror and write your issues with the scriptures next to them, what you need to fix, and at the top write: execute. Those are your orders for the day. If you don't see it, you're never going to fix it. Too many brothers and sisters don't write anything down: notes done, Bible closed the rest of the week, and then they're stressing, when the fix to what they were dealing with last week and what they will face this week came out in the class. We don't examine ourselves.

Don't ask the captain what he sees in you. What do you see in you? Leadership has the blessing of discernment, but that only goes so far; we can't see through you or know all the deep recesses of what you're dealing with. You have to go before the Lord, explain it, confess it, and ask him in sincerity to remove those things from you.

Don't play with what you know you are dealing with. The spirits on brothers and sisters who could care less can rub off even on leadership; a lot of brothers and sisters are spiritual vampires, and it takes a toll on leaders who love our people. God has this hospital set up for you to get the help, and the medicine is the laws. You have a headache, you don't throw the Tylenol in the trash, you take it. So why throw away the medicine when it concerns your soul and your salvation? Why be fearful of freedom?

“Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.” Keep yourselves in the love of God, not in the crosshairs of his anger, his rage, his wrath. It is our job to keep ourselves there. I can't save you, and you can't save me. It ain't going to be easy; you have to go through this fiery trial to get the kingdom. So do your part. You have the keys to freedom, and that is the trust that keeps the mind stayed on the Lord in perfect peace.

precepts.text: Certain men crept in unawares, before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men turning the grace of God into lasciviousness. Picking up a Bible does not mean God sent you; some are ordained as a proving ground for whether you follow man or the word. If their conversation is being sidekick to the Diddler and the Hebrew Hammer, ask whether they were sent or ordained to try you.
precepts.point: Believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God, because many false prophets are gone out into the world. You try them with the Bible. That goes for the Christian church too, and for anyone who says he believes on Christ and calls himself an Israelite.

note.label: Fixx Ya Face Fridays | as Was Supposed!!

precepts.why:
John says “believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God”. And everybody that picks up a Bible is not called or sent by God. Some picked up that Bible because they were before ordained, to prove you: “For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation”. That is their lot. God created them for this reason, to be a proving ground for you: are you going to follow man, or the word of God?

They are “ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness”. The grace of God is us being called into this truth, knowing that we are Israelites. So if these men come to you saying they speak on behalf of God, but most of their conversation is being the sidekick to the Diddler and the Hebrew Hammer, selling their body, oily pecs, then you have to question: are these men really sent by God, or are they ordained to try me?

That is why the Bible warns us to try the spirits, and the way to try them is by these scriptures. Are they living up to the scriptures? Are they speaking according to what the scriptures say? Or are they men of old ordained to draw you away? Examine that, brothers and sisters. And it isn't only them; it is for anybody who says they believe in Christ and the Bible and calls themselves an Israelite, and for the Christian pastors too, because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

precepts.text: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things; every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment; by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words condemned. If you cannot prove it in the scriptures, it is an idle word. These men condemn themselves trying to sound deep when the Lord said his laws are simple.
precepts.point: Because judgment is not executed speedily they think they can say anything about Jesus; he is writing it in a book and coming back to say, say that to my face. That is how you know Jesus is a black man.

note.label: Fixx Ya Face Fridays | as Was Supposed!!

precepts.why:
Enoch prophesied “Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints, To execute judgment upon all”, and to convince the ungodly “of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.” Off top, he rides deep; he's got a crew. Because judgment is not executed speedily, they think they can say whatever they want about Jesus: a stripper, making it rain on him. He's getting it all written down in a book, and he's coming back to say, say that to my face. That's how you know Jesus is a black man.

Christ said it himself: “A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.” That is what comes out of you. “But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.” If you cannot prove it in the scriptures, it is an idle word. “For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.”

These men are condemning themselves. It isn't enough to say Jesus is my way because he gave his life for us; he has to be a stripper, butt naked. They sit down and write these sermons thinking they are saying something deep and profound. Why go through all that to concoct lies when the Lord said his laws are simple? There is simplicity in Christ, and keeping God's commandments is very easy to do. Every idle word will be accounted for in that day.

precepts.text: They bend their tongues like their bow for lies, but they are not valiant for the truth. Instead of teaching the commandments they concoct sayings to look wise and bewitch you a little at a time, until you are sitting under a man calling Jesus a stripper and see nothing wrong.
precepts.point: Because judgment is not executed speedily they think they can say anything about Jesus; he is writing it in a book and coming back to say, say that to my face. That is how you know Jesus is a black man.

note.label: Fixx Ya Face Fridays | as Was Supposed!!

precepts.why:
“And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies”. Instead of just keeping God's commandments and teaching God's commandments, they concoct wise sayings to look a certain way in front of men. What they are really doing is trying to bewitch you, dropping a little in your windows here and there, until the next thing you know you're sitting in a congregation where he's saying Jesus is a stripper, supporting it, and seeing nothing wrong with it.

They want to explain Christ in a negative light, or raise money by talking about Diddy coming out, because the people they are reaching have defiled minds. They aren't leading them back to God; they keep them in the same state. When you can get people to laugh at something that foul, it is because it engages their spirit: you are tapping into something familiar to them that they have not cast out. Our job is to lead them away from that mentality, and these men are trying to keep them in it.

Then, “but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth”. All they have to do is keep God's commandments. How about you be valiant about doing what God actually tells you to do? Enoch said the Lord comes to convince the ungodly of their hard speeches against him, and these bent tongues are those hard speeches.

precepts.text: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means, and my people love to have it so. You love to have it so, but you are not valiant for God's laws, and you will suffer the consequences because you had a space to repent and rejected it for a fool. Tell them the truth and they say not my Jesus; call him a stripper and they say amen.
precepts.point: Because judgment is not executed speedily they think they can say anything about Jesus; he is writing it in a book and coming back to say, say that to my face. That is how you know Jesus is a black man.

note.label: Fixx Ya Face Fridays | as Was Supposed!!

precepts.why:
Watch this: they know they are up there speaking outside the Bible. He didn't have a Bible in his hand, just the silly glasses and the loud outfit. “The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so”.

What baffles us about Christianity is that when you give them the truth out of the Bible, they say, not my Jesus. But when somebody said he was a stripper, nobody said not my Jesus. Everybody said amen. Tell them Christ is coming back to give us glory and set up his kingdom on earth and we're going to rule it, and it's not my Jesus. My people love to have it so.

You love to have it so, but you are not valiant for God's laws. So when Christ comes back, “with ten thousands of his saints, To execute judgment upon all”, you will suffer the consequences, because you had a space to repent and you rejected it for some fool saying Christ was a stripper instead of saying he is your Lord and Saviour. He is going to hold you accountable for what you did or did not do while you had the opportunity. This is the King of kings and Lord of lords, and you lowered him to a woman selling her body in a strip club.

precepts.text: The sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair.
precepts.point: The angels which kept not their first estate are reserved in everlasting chains under darkness. The sons of God who took the daughters of men were Israelites who fell into fornication.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
“And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.” The angels here are the sons of God from the beginning of the Bible: Seth's line, Adam's chosen, righteous line of children.

Jude 7 shows what they did: “Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh”. In like manner means the angels of verse 6 did the same thing the Sodomites did: gave themselves over to fornication. The strange flesh is the sons of God stepping outside their own line and dealing with Cain's lineage, the daughters of men.

Genesis 6 is that fornication: “That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.” Then, “My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.” God cut their lifespan short because of it. The sons of God went into fornication, and that is how they fell from their first estate.

They were reserved in chains under darkness. Like the prophets and seers whose eyes were covered, they were reserved from the beginning to reject Christ, the black Messiah. Their fathers were murderers, and the same murderers came back in their children.

precepts.point: The angels which kept not their first estate are reserved in everlasting chains under darkness. The sons of God who took the daughters of men were Israelites who fell into fornication.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
“For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment”. The angels that sinned are the sons of God in Genesis. Cast down means cast down from their powerful estate. Delivered into chains of darkness, they came right back as the Pharisees, scribes and Sadducees, who were in darkness.

Luke 16 shows them: “And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him. And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.” Today it is going on podcasts and arguing for fame and attention. Christ then spoke of putting away a wife, because the Pharisees were adulterers and fornicators, and the rich man of his parable was the Pharisees, while Lazarus was the disciples, the people under their rule.

2 Peter 2:10: “But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.” Jude 8 says the same: “these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.” It says they are not afraid, which means you are supposed to be afraid. There is a consequence. When you say Paul was a false prophet, call John's camp fake, or disrespect Christ, Moses or the twelve, darkness falls upon you. Then comes nation salvation, and people saying they will start wearing Israeli fringes and yarmulkes and speaking Yiddish.

Christ's parable ends the same way: “Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness”. He was reserved for darkness from the very beginning; some are predestined for light and some for darkness. “For many are called, but few are chosen.” There are many Israelites, but not all Israel is of Israel.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
In the parable the husbandmen beat the servants the lord of the vineyard sent, entreated them shamefully and sent them away empty, and when the beloved son came they said, “This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.” The servants are the prophets they killed. Jude shows what kind of men do that: “Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.”

Speaking evil of dignities is how you know these are the ones reserved for darkness. Remember what Christ asked them: “The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?” They reasoned, if we say from heaven, he will ask why we did not believe him. They spoke evil of John, and he was a dignity. They spoke evil of Christ, a dignity. They spoke evil of the twelve, dignities.

Peter says the same: “they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.” Not afraid means you are supposed to be afraid; there is a consequence when you do it. When you say Paul was a false prophet, when you say John was a fake Israelite camp, when you disrespect Christ, Moses and the twelve disciples, bad things follow. Darkness falls upon you. Now the nations can be saved, we're not Israelites no more, we're going to wear Israeli fringes and yarmulkes and speak Yiddish: darkness falls upon you for speaking evil of dignities.

So the lord of the vineyard “shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others”, and when they heard it they said, God forbid. They knew he was talking about them.

The giants in the earth came from the sons of God intermingling with the other nations. The children born to them “became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.”

Jude speaks of “the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation”. Those angels are these same men of Genesis 6:4. Another word for angel is messenger. They came from the lineage of Adam, and their first estate was sons of God; when they came in unto the daughters of men they left that estate. For it the Most High “hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.”

note.label: Genesis 19: The Destruction of Sodom

precepts.why:
When Lot entered Zoar, “the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven.” Jude says why that overthrow is written: “Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.”

They gave themselves over to fornication and went after strange flesh, and they are set forth for an example. What was done there on a small scale is done in spiritual Sodom on a greater scale, and the example stands.

Notice too that the angel could not act until Lot was out: “Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither.” The destruction waited on the righteous being brought out, the same way the angels in Revelation 7 hold the four winds until the servants of God are sealed.

“These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water,” You see that part, clouds they are without water? Likewise today you have men who appear like they have the wisdom and understanding of God, but within there is no rain, there is no water, there is no truth. Your feasts of charity are the Sabbath day and any other kind of gathering that God commanded us to do.

“carried about of winds;” Meaning any time a doctrine comes, that brother or sister goes with it. “trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit,” Without fruits of the spirit; that is what it is making reference to. “twice dead,” You know why it says twice dead? Because before you heard the gospel you were dead in the world. You repented of your sins, you came into the truth, then somewhere along the line you allowed something to happen or interfere with your walk with the Lord, and now you are dead all over again, trapped up in sin. So now you are twice dead. “plucked up by the roots;”

precepts.why:

Our job as teachers is to give you the tools necessary for what you need; it is your job to build yourself up. It is like going to the gym. I can't lift the weight for you. You are 300 pounds of blubber and you want to lose weight; I can't exercise for you. You have to build up yourself. Likewise in the scriptures the Lord says build up yourselves on your most holy faith: that means you have to read four chapters a day, you have to ask questions, you have to take notes, you have to do that thing, because if you don't, what we read in Mark 4 about the cares of the world, the deceitfulness of riches and the lusts of other things will creep in and choke the word. Praying in the Holy Ghost: praying according to the law.

The key is verse 21: “Keep yourselves in the love of God,” Keep yourselves in the love of God. “looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.” You have to pray for mercy. You are looking for the love of God? You better pray for mercy daily.

“And of some have compassion, making a difference:” Some brothers and sisters we can have compassion on; we talk to you soft: hey brother, hey sister, you all right? That works with some spirits. And others save with fear: others we have to curse you out, because you are at the brink of death and we can't sit down and talk all night with you. We see you are about to die in the spirit, so now we have to deal a little harsher with you. So don't think, oh, you're not in the love of Jesus.
